name: CHGPWD
helpText: Change the password for the current user profile. Stock IBM i GO SECURITY paths route here from SECURITY option 20.
secondLevelHelp: Enter current, new, and verified new password on the CHGPWD panel. Training passwords remain uppercase like sign-on.

name: CHGUSRPRF
helpText: Changes selected attributes of a user profile in the lab runtime. Use to enable/disable accounts or review privileged profile posture during missions.
secondLevelHelp: On IBM i, CHGUSRPRF changes profile attributes such as status, password, and special authorities. This lab implements a subset for governance training.
realismLimits: Subset of profile attributes modeled. No real password policy enforcement.
